# Tauri app frontend selection — framework choice and static export configuration

Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills' tauri-app-frontend-selection skill: guidance for choosing and configuring a frontend framework for Tauri v2 — clarifying SSR, SSG, and static-export requirements, recommending Vite by default unless SSR is genuinely required, providing static-export configuration for Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Qwik, and Trunk, and aligning output paths with Tauri asset loading, with links to the official v2.tauri.app frontend docs per framework. It produces a framework recommendation with rationale and a static-export configuration checklist, with a declared boundary (framework selection and initialization — static export configuration and output directory mapping).
